motion_rule: the belt hauls him down the hall all clip while coin towers, cages and the auditor sweep across and burst at the lens every beat; the camera swings round him without stopping, his face to the lens, his head half the frame; new shot size each beat, one big action per beat; the tall frame filled, no bars
character: a small slow loris with enormous round eyes and heavy rings under them, muzzle always clear of his paws
second_characters: ONE shrew auditor in a grey sleeve guard, big in frame a shoulder from the lens, hurling coin bags across the belt
props: ONE paper tally roll trailing from his paw, longer every beat, only carried, swung or hurled, never worked in place
prop_continuity: the tally roll shows from 0.00 and grows every beat; at 7.75 the auditor rips it away; from 8.45 one coin is all he holds
environment: a coin counting hall at noon, daylight through the glass roof, sorting cages and coin towers a paw away both sides of the belt, trolleys packed along it, no far wall
light_events: blazing noon, white bounce off the towers onto his muzzle, a hard glint on the coin at 8.45

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: a small hoarse voice worn flat by a sleepless shift, biting each word, 4 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: ma-I gla-ZA, KRUG-ly-e, ne OT, u-div-LE-ni-ya, a OT, ne-do-SY-pa, STOL-ko, schi-TAT, NA-do
audio.pacing: 0.55-3.85, 3.85-5.35 and 5.95-7.75 each one breath; after 7.75 not a word, sfx keep going
audio.lip_sync: his mouth opens wide and shapes every syllable
audio.sfx: the belt grinding, coins pouring, cage doors clanging

timeline.a: the belt hauls him past a tower and a cage swings across over his head
he drags both paws down his face and lets the lids snap back open at the lens
he hauls the tally roll up out of the coin pile and it unspools across the frame
he swings his head round as a coin bag flies past his ear
the auditor hurls a bag onto the belt beside him and it bursts, coins raking across
he throws a paw out and rides the jolt as the belt kicks under him
he shoves the roll under his chin and props his own eyelid up with one claw
a whole cage of coins tips beside the belt and pours past him crosswise
he heaves the growing roll over his shoulder like a rope
he flings a paw at the towers going past and the roll whips after it
he swings the whole roll across the frame and it slaps the coin tower
the auditor bangs a stamp on the roll, rips it out of his paws and hauls it off the belt
the auditor flips one coin at him without looking and keeps walking; it hits his chest and he grabs it
he holds the one coin up at the lens, his round eyes stretching wider than the coin
behind him the towers he counted all shift roll away down the hall and out through the gates

must_appear: the tally roll growing every beat until it is ripped away at 7.75; his enormous round eyes with heavy rings; at 8.45 the auditor flips him one coin and that coin is all he keeps; at 9.70 the towers he counted roll away behind him
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, night, dark scene, cyrillic letters, words, a parked camera, a closed mouth while speaking, slow motion, a camera pulling back, an empty hall, a far wall, a foreign accent, a word not in the lines
